messages:
maria (product): Quick check — we need to pick sequencing for Dedicated vs Private for the next sprint. FinRegCorp is pressing for VPC + KMS (private), but Capacity teams are saying Dedicated buys predictable throughput and faster onboarding. Can we do a quick RICE-style crosswalk and state launch gating criteria?...
kevin (pm): +1. I'd prioritize customer risk/external demand. Quick RICE from me below.
kevin (pm): Dedicated: Reach=1200 requests/day (estimate for target customers), Impact=2.5, Confidence=0.7, Effort=18 pw -> RICE=(1200*2.5*0.7)/18 ≈ 116
kevin (pm): Private: Reach=300 requests/day (enterprisey), Impact=3.0, Confidence=0.6, Effort=26 pw -> RICE=(300*3*0.6)/26 ≈ 20.8
chris (eng-runtime): numbers look reasonable. caveats: Dedicated effort assumes existing autoscale + pool plumbing. Private requires KMS/HSM work, network agent, and packaging for air-gapped installs — hidden effort + infra support.
alicia (sales): From deals — HealthCorp and FinRegCorp both asked for Private. They'd convert at 6-9 months ARR commitment. So reach might be understated for Private if we close both.
alicia (sales): also: sales-driven revenue makes Impact higher for Private but confidence lower until we spike KMS integration.
pete (solutions): From implementation POV, Dedicated is faster to demo and iterate. Private has compliance gating: audits, SOC2 enhancements, legal approval.
chris (eng-runtime): Can we decouple core runtime from packaging? If we treat Private as packaging + ops docs, we can reduce the dev effort by ~30%.
kevin (pm): Good point. Revised Effort Private -> 18 pw if packaging outsourced to partners. Revised RICE Private ≈ (300*3*0.6)/18 ≈ 30
maria (product): Ok — still lower than Dedicated but higher strategic value. Suggest we 1) prioritize Dedicated in Q1 to hit throughput & early customers 2) run a 6-week private spike (KMS + agent POC) with clear acceptance criteria so we can move fast if contract closed.
maria (product): Spike acceptance criteria: a) KMS integration end-to-end (rotate keys) b) deployable agent image + docs c) E2E test with a customer VPC d) SLOs validated (p95 < 300ms) e) legal checklist completed.
chris (eng-runtime): Add: automated install script + rollback; and ability to toggle telemetry off for air-gapped installs.
kevin (pm): Risks: Sales may push for Private-first if large deal imminent. Suggest a gating policy: if TCV > $500k and contract needs private in <=90 days -> fast-track Private (resource pool reserved), otherwise standard pipeline (Dedicated first).
alicia (sales): Agreed. Can we add a negotiation playbook? Offer dedicated pilot + parallel private implementation with milestone payments.
pete (solutions): I'll draft a checklist for the customer implementation plan. Will include timing, assumptions, and dependencies (KMS, IP allowlist, on-prem infra sizing).
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary for dedicated-pool v2 at 03:00 UTC — owners: @chris
sre-bot: FYI — Dedicated pool autoscaler alerting needs rule tweak. filing ticket #INF-4021
maria (product): Next steps: kevin to write short RICE memo + gating policy; chris to scope private spike tasks w/ estimate; pete to draft implementation checklist; alicia to flag any urgent deals.
kevin (pm): Will drop a doc by EOD with scores and the gating rule.
alicia (sales): Flagged FinRegCorp for legal intake, asking for 60-day timeline. :eyes:
chris (eng-runtime): I'll post spike task list in eng-runtime channel once scoped.
maria (product): Thanks — sync in the triage tomorrow 10:15. If sales fires, we run fast-track.
kevin (pm): noted.
pete (solutions): noted.
